meta.title: HTML Minifier & Beautifier - Free Online Tool
meta.description: Compress or format HTML code instantly - minify for production or beautify for development
meta.subtitle: Compress or format HTML code instantly

content.about_desc: An HTML Minifier is a tool that compresses HTML code by removing unnecessary characters like whitespace, comments, and line breaks without changing functionality. Minified HTML files are significantly smaller, leading to faster page load times and improved website performance. Our free online HTML minifier also includes a beautify feature to format HTML with proper indentation for better readability during development.
content.why_desc: Minifying HTML is important for web performance optimization. Smaller HTML files mean faster downloads, reduced bandwidth usage, and improved page load times. This is especially beneficial for large websites with lots of HTML content. Minified HTML reduces server load and improves user experience.

features_list.minify: Minify HTML: Remove whitespace and comments to reduce file size
features_list.beautify: Beautify HTML: Format HTML with proper indentation

how_steps.1: Click "Minify HTML" to compress the code
how_steps.2: Click "Beautify HTML" to format with indentation
how_steps.3: Copy the output using "Copy Output" button
how_steps.4: Use the minified HTML in your production environment to reduce bandwidth and improve page load speed.
